title: Tensor product with a constant complex
statement:
Let $X$ be a
quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme with $\kuncd(X)<\infty$ and let $\Lambda$ be
a torsion ring. For $E\in D(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and
$K\in D(\Lambda)$, the canonical map

$$
\RGamma(X_{\Et},E)\kunotimes{\Lambda}K\longrightarrow
\RGamma\bigl(X_{\Et},E\kunotimes{\Lambda}\underline{K}\bigr)
$$

is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a natural uniform bound from sInf_lt_iff and the finite torsion cohomological dimension. The positive characteristic relation annihilates every section of every Λ-module sheaf, so its underlying abelian sheaf is torsion. Transfer the resulting abelian cohomology vanishing along nonempty_etaleModuleCohomology_forgetIso. An underlying subsingleton module is a zero object. Integer degrees above the natural bound are natural. This gives HasFiniteCohomologicalDimension Λ X for the actual coefficient ring.
Apply the already proved preservesCoproducts_rightDerivedGlobalSections for the bound just obtained. No finite-cardinality assumption on the torsion ring is needed.

Work generically with an exact additive strong monoidal f preserving flat objects, and its derived adjunction L ⊣ R. Use the functorial flat resolution to exhibit every derived object as Qh of a representative whose f-image is K-flat. Functor.OplaxMonoidal.ofLaxSquare descends the fixed leftDerivedTensorComparison and its counit square to an oplax structure on L. Its unit is the composite of the Qh unit, the derived counit, the ordinary monoidal unit and the inverse Qh unit; each factor is invertible. Adjunction.isIso_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app_tensorUnit therefore proves the projection map invertible at the tensor unit. The same functorial resolution supplies a K-flat representative for the first tensor factor. The equation leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom and commShift_of_tensorLeft_fac prove shift compatibility there; naturality along its localization isomorphism transports it to the original factor. This constructs the unit argument directly from generic source APIs and avoids the integral-coefficient module.

Identify L with the termwise exact mapDerivedCategory functor by leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Transport its shift and triangulated structures along this isomorphism. The adjunction equips R with compatible shift and triangulated structures. Its counit and the tensor comparison commute with shifts, so Adjunction.commShift_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app makes the projection transformation commute with shifts. The source derived closed monoidal structure makes each tensorLeft exact and coproduct preserving. L preserves coproducts by its adjunction, and R does by step 2; hence both sides of the projection transformation preserve coproducts. These are applications of proved generic source-library APIs, replacing the separate ringed-site infrastructure in the former plan.

Specialize the generic argument to constantSheaf and derivedConstantGlobalSectionsAdjunction. Apply the source module generator isomorphism test to each fixed E. The singleFunctorObjUnitIso identifies the degree-zero free rank-one module with the derived tensor unit, where step 3 proves invertibility. Therefore every component K is invertible. The stable constantProjectionComponents evaluation package has component_eq equal to reflexivity, so its component is exactly the original canonical constantDerivedProjectionMap, with unchanged signature and data.
